newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE confirms certified coffee stocks 4008 lots.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE confirms certified coffee stocks 4008 lots.

text.p: Coffee certified stocks held in LIFFE (London International Financial Futures Exchange) nominated warehouses totalled 4008 five tonne lots at the end of March, a LIFFE release said.

The LIFFE release showed the stocks were spread across the approved warehouses as follows - U.K. 2, Rotterdam 249, Amsterdam Nil, Hamburg 162, Bremen, 134, Antwerp 2,169, Le Havre 346,Barcelona 367, Trieste 7, New York 2 and New Orleans 570.
